facts.fact: Biometric Update, citing Tech Review Africa, reports that Mozambique's Digital Certification System operates under the country's Electronic Transactions Law and Digital Certification Regulation; the report gives no enactment date, so it is dated to the document's published date.

The report names a Digital Certification Regulation under which, with the Electronic Transactions Law, the Digital Certification System operates and which is meant to establish the authenticity and integrity of digital signatures; it gives no date for the regulation, so it is dated to the published date.
